title: PHOTO GALLERY: RCS wins battle of unbeaten Lady Warriors - NewsBreak
text:
By RANDY BALL ,
17 hours ago
ROGERSVILLE — Rogersville City School visited RMS on Thursday, March 26 for a battle of unbeaten Lady Warrior softball teams.
The RCS Lady Warriors used a six-run third inning to top RMS 10-5.
Greer Banks pitched for RCS, while Addy Mullins was in the circle for RMS. Banks gave up five runs (one earned) on six hits with three walks and 12 strikeouts. Mullins gave up 10 runs (five earned) on five hits with 13 walks and 14 strikeouts.
RCS led 1-0 after one inning, with Carter Thurman scoring the run. RMS put four runs on the board in the second. Riley Carter hit a single, with two RBIs. Paisley McMillan, Millie Griffin, Giana Pearson and Mullins each scored.
In the third inning, RCS used five walks to help score six runs. Thurman, Kyra Pope, Ayriona Holmes, Reece Floyd, Banks and Ava Gibson scored runs in the third.
Paisley McMillan scored in the fourth inning for RMS, driven in by a Riley Carter single. In the fifth, RCS added runs by Gibson and Claira Allen. The final run came in the sixth, with Holmes scoring to provide the final margin.
Thurman, Holmes and Gibson each scored two runs for RCS. Thurman was 2-for-3 at the plate with a pair of doubles and two RBIs. Allen and Banks each drove in a run.
McMillan scored twice for RMS. Riley Carter was 2-for-3 with two RBIs. McMillan, Emma Dalton, Avery Kenny, Pearson and Mullins each had one hit for RMS.
RCS (7-0) will travel to North Greene on Monday, March 30 at 5:30 p.m. and to Boones Creek on Tuesday, March 31 at 5 p.m. West Greene visits RCS on Thursday, April 2 at 5:30 p.m.
RMS (5-1) will travel to Chuckey-Doak on Monday, March 30 at 5:30 p.m. and return home on Tuesday, March 31 to host Hancock County at 6 p.m. Surgoinsville will visit RMS on Thursday, April 2 at 5 p.m.
